articles.headline: Winless Chargers sticking with Mike McDaniel as offensive playcaller
articles.description: Embattled offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel will continue as the Chargers' playcaller, coach Jim Harbaugh announced Wednesday.
articles.headlineJa: 勝ち星のないチャージャーズ、マイク・マクダニエルをオフェンシブ・プレイコーラーに据え続ける
articles.descriptionJa: ジム・ハーボーヘッドコーチは水曜日、苦境に立たされているオフェンシブコーディネーターのマイク・マクダニエルが引き続きチャージャーズのプレイコーラーを務めることを発表した。
articles.body:
Embattled offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel will continue as the Los Angeles Chargers' playcaller, coach Jim Harbaugh announced Wednesday.

"We're very confident in Mike and his talent, his work ethic and his ability," Harbaugh told reporters, according to The Athletic. "We continue to be."

Harbaugh made the decision after the organization's self-scouting over their bye week.

"I feel like every stone, any part that we could look to better, that's the way we responded," Harbaugh said.

Before their Week 7 bye, the Chargers scored a season-low six points in a Week 6 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs. The Chargers managed just 259 total yards and lowered their league-worst points-per-game average to 15.0 in the 22-6 loss, which dropped them to 0-6 on the season. They are the league's last winless team this season. 

McDaniel, who was fired in January after four seasons as the head coach of the Miami Dolphins, joined the Chargers this offseason to jump-start a Chargers offense that had scored only one touchdown over two playoff losses under Harbaugh.

McDaniel said his goal was to help Justin Herbert, whom he called as talented a quarterback as he had ever been around, "own" the position.

That process began with Herbert changing his shotgun stance over the offseason, moving his left foot in front of his right. It's a change McDaniel has made with other quarterbacks, most recently with Tua Tagovailoa in Miami, who had his only Pro Bowl in Year 2 under McDaniel. Herbert took days off from throwing at practice, instead practicing footwork while going through a throwing motion with a green water ball while McDaniel watched closely.

Instead, the Chargers' offense and Herbert have never looked worse. He has thrown interceptions directly to defenders: to Buffalo Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson in Week 3, then two picks to Seattle Seahawks linebacker Drake Thomas and linebacker Ernest Jones IV in Week 4. He has looked like a shell of the player many consider to be among the league's top quarterbacks, as the Chargers have piled up losses.

Herbert is tied for the NFL lead with eight interceptions this season.

McDaniel arrived in Los Angeles as one of the most respected offensive playcallers in the NFL, responsible for some of the greatest offenses in league history. In 2023, his Dolphins beat the Denver Broncos 70-20 with 700-plus yards of offense in a game and tied the record for points scored in a game.

ESPN's Kris Rhim contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Lakers rule out Luka Doncic, Ziaire Williams vs. Clippers
articles.description: Lakers star Luka Doncic (back) and starter Ziaire Williams (foot) will not play in Wednesday's game vs. the Clippers, who will be without Rui Hachimura (quad).
articles.headlineJa: レイカーズ、クリッパーズ戦にルカ・ドンチッチとゼイア・ウィリアムズが出場しないことを発表
articles.descriptionJa: レイカーズのスター、ルカ・ドンチッチ（背中）とスターターのゼイア・ウィリアムズ（足）は、水曜日のクリッパーズ戦に出場しない。一方、クリッパーズは八村塁（大腿四頭筋）を欠く。
articles.body:
Los Angeles Lakers star Luka Doncic will not play against the LA Clippers on Wednesday at Intuit Dome because of back tightness, the team announced.

Doncic scored 41 points in the Lakers' 136-129 loss to the Portland Trail Blazers on Tuesday -- the team's first loss of the season after a 3-0 start. He leads the league with a 36.0 points per game scoring average one week into the NBA season.

The Lakers, playing on the second night of a back-to-back, will also be down starter Ziaire Williams due to left foot soreness.

On the other side, the Clippers will be without forward Rui Hachimura, who has left quad soreness. Kobe Sanders will make his first start of the season in Hachimura's place.

Hachimura scored 16 points against his former team last week in the Lakers' 125-117 win over the Clippers at Crypto.com Arena.

articles.headline: Packers and Panthers trying to bounce back as they face off at Lambeau Field
articles.description: — A pair of ticked-off teams will square off when the Green Bay Packers face the Carolina Panthers on Thursday night.
articles.headlineJa: パッカーズとパンサーズ、ランボーフィールドでの対戦で巻き返しを狙う
articles.descriptionJa: 木曜夜、グリーンベイ・パッカーズとカロライナ・パンサーズという、不満を抱える2チームが激突する。
articles.body:
GREEN BAY, Wis. -- — A pair of ticked-off teams will square off when the Green Bay Packers face the Carolina Panthers on Thursday night.


              The Packers (4-3) are angry over a 20-17 loss at Detroit in which they got penalized seven times in the second half, leading to postgame critiques of the officiating. Carolina (3-3) is mad at itself after getting blown out 43-13 at home by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.


              So neither team should have any trouble finding motivation.


              “Just for us, this is the next game, this is the next championship opportunity,” Panthers coach Dave Canales said. "But I’m also fully aware there’s a human element involved. And for us, coming off of that loss in the fashion that we lost, for the Packers, a really tough loss for them as well, there’s something that burns inside of you as a competitor. And in me, in our players, certainly in the Green Bay Packers’ locker room, too.”


              Green Bay comes into this one with injury issues on its offensive line after losing starting center Sean Rhyan and backup Jacob Monk in the Lions game. Right guard Travis Glover won't play Thursday due to a knee issue.


              This continues a season-long problem for the Packers, who have had different starting offensive line combinations in each of their first four games.


              “It’s different, but at the end of the day, we still trust the guys,” said Packers running back Josh Jacobs, who made his season debut Sunday after spending Green Bay’s first six games on the commissioner’s exempt list. “I know for the running backs and the O-line, we met together just with us. We went over the film and stuff like that, and the standard is still the standard regardless of who’s in there.”


              Green Bay also will be missing linebacker Zaire Franklin (shin) for a second straight game. Carolina has ruled out cornerback Akayleb Evans (triceps/knee), guard Damien Lewis (knee), outside linebacker Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and offensive lineman Torricelli Simpkins (ankle).


              This represents a rematch of a game the Panthers won 16-13 at Lambeau Field last year. 


              “We know that doesn’t entitle us to anything," Panthers quarterback Bryce Young said. "It’s a new year, new season, new guys on both sides of the ball. For us, that’s not something we’re pulling from or referencing.”


              The Packers lost to Carolina last season in part because of their inability to capitalize when they got inside the opponent’s 35-yard line, a problem that also proved costly Sunday at Detroit.


              Carolina would love to see its defense show that same kind of stinginess Thursday after allowing the Buccaneers to run wild.

articles.headline: Eagles star Saquon Barkley says he was forced to divest Polymarket equity stake
articles.description: Eagles star Saquon Barkley said he was forced to divest his equity stake in Polymarket to comply with NFL rules.
articles.headlineJa: イーグルスのスター、サクオン・バークリーがPolymarketの株式売却を余儀なくされたと明かす
articles.descriptionJa: イーグルスのスター、サクオン・バークリーは、NFLの規定に従うため、Polymarketの持分を売却せざるを得なかったと述べた。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley said he was forced to divest his equity stake in Polymarket to comply with NFL rules that prohibit players from investing in gambling or prediction-market companies.

Barkley told Front Office Sports that the league relays to players before each season what they can and can't endorse and invest in, and that being involved with prediction markets is no longer allowed.

"I was in it before, but no bueno," he told Front Office Sports, which posted its report about Barkley on Wednesday.

According to Front Office Sports, an NFL Players Association spokesperson said earlier in the year that the league "views prediction markets as gambling entities, so players are not allowed to be an endorser or brand ambassador for a company like Kalshi or Polymarket under the gambling policy."

Barkley has been active in the investment space. He has invested upwards of $500,000 in startup companies like Anthropic, Anduril, Ramp, Cognition, Neuralink, Strike, and Polymarket, according to a 2025 report by The Profile.

The NFL's stance on prediction market partnerships appears to differ from other sports. The NBA, Major League Baseball, NHL and MLS all have deals with either Kalshi, Polymarket or both.

The NFL asked the U.S. Supreme Court earlier this month to review whether prediction markets' sports-event contracts, which mimic traditional sports betting, fall under the purview of state gambling regulators.

A league source told ESPN's David Purdum that the NFL's primary desire is for the court to provide clarity on the issue quickly, adding that the league would accept a federal framework if it provided the same regulatory approach as states.

articles.headline: NFL survivor power rankings: Why this is the week to use Bengals, Patriots
articles.description: ESPN NFL survivor pool strategy, predictions and ranking the top six options for Week 8.
articles.headlineJa: NFLサバイバー・パワーランキング：今週ベンガルズとペイトリオッツを使うべき理由
articles.descriptionJa: ESPNによるNFLサバイバープールの戦略、予想、および第8週のトップ6オプションのランキング。
articles.body:
This season continues to have no mercy for Survivor players. Another 41% of the remaining entries were chopped off last week, leaving just 2.3% of the initial entries remaining after Week 7.

At least one favorite of at least seven points has lost in each of the first seven weeks, the first time that has happened since 1972. In each of the past two weeks, the only double-digit favorite on the board lost outright. Two weeks ago, the Los Angeles Rams fell to the Arizona Cardinals. Last week, it was the Houston Texans losing in overtime against the New York Giants.

Over 39% of the remaining entries have been eliminated in every week except Week 4. Last week, the New York Jets also made a significant dent in the pool, as users who adhered to the fade-Miami strategy were burned.

This week, the biggest favorite on the board is the Cincinnati Bengals, and they will likely be the most popular pick despite only being 51% available. The Bengals have the easiest schedule remaining in the NFL according to ESPN Analytics, but they will have no better spot than this week, so the chalk is justified.

After that, there are several other strong options. The Jacksonville Jaguars are nearly as big of favorites as the Bengals at a lower selection. The Rams, New England Patriots and Dallas Cowboys are all favored by about a touchdown, and all three have less future value than the Bengals or Jaguars.

There are even more viable options down the board. The Washington Commanders are off a bye hosting the Philadelphia Eagles. The Pittsburgh Steelers face a Cleveland Browns team they have beaten 22 straight times at home in the regular season. Even the Buffalo Bills could be a good pick against the Baltimore Ravens if Lamar Jackson is ruled out.

With so many players eliminated, it has never been more important to plan your route and know your competition. Check what teams your competitors still have available. If there are only a few people left, look at their tendencies in past weeks. Start to map out your picks for the remaining 12 weeks.

My top pick will vary from contest to contest. For single-pick contests like on ESPN, I like eating the chalk with the Bengals, or perhaps pivoting to the New England Patriots or Dallas Cowboys. If my group has double-pick weeks coming up, I prefer to save the Bengals and opt for the Patriots, Rams or Cowboys.

Note: Odds by DraftKings and subject to change. Future value based on Mike Clay's cheat sheet.

The Bengals are the simplest choice if you're just looking to pick the biggest favorite and move on. articles.headline: Updated NBA championship and MVP odds: Spurs take control; Thunder lose ground
articles.description: The San Antonio Spurs are the early favorites to win the NBA championship, with Victor Wembanyama the fave to take home MVP honors.
articles.headlineJa: NBA優勝およびMVP予想オッズ更新：スパーズが優位に、サンダーは後退
articles.descriptionJa: サンアントニオ・スパーズがNBA優勝の初期本命となっており、ビクター・ウェンバンヤマがMVP受賞の最有力候補となっている。
articles.body:
One week into the 2026-27 NBA season, there have already been some big shake-ups to the NBA Finals odds board.

At the top, the San Antonio Spurs are now the standalone favorites for the title at +285 after previously sharing the honor with the Oklahoma City Thunder at +270. OKC has dropped down to +380 amid a slew of injuries to start the season, including long-term ones to Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace.

After a poor start to the season, the reigning champion New York Knicks dropped from a tie with the Philadelphia 76ers at +900 to a tie with the Boston Celtics at 10-1; Boston improved from 13-1 after a 3-1 start.

Several other teams made big moves up the championship board in the span of the first week, including the Toronto Raptors (25-1 to 15-1), Minnesota Timberwolves (25-1 to 16-1) and Houston Rockets (35-1 to 16-1).

Meanwhile, the much-hyped Miami Heat, led by Giannis Antetokounmpo, have lengthened from 30-1 to 55-1 for the title after failing to win a game in the season's first week. Antetokounmpo dropped from 14-1 to 16-1 on the MVP odds board, which still features Victor Wembanyama (+210) at the top.

articles.headline: Ernie Johnson says this is his final season as 'Inside the NBA' host
articles.description: Ernie Johnson will retire as host of "Inside the NBA" after the season, saying it was his decision to step away and that "it's just time."
articles.headlineJa: アーニー・ジョンソン、「Inside the NBA」の司会として今シーズンが最後になると発表
articles.descriptionJa: アーニー・ジョンソンは、今シーズン終了後に「Inside the NBA」の司会を退任する。自身の決断であることを明かし、「ただ、その時が来たのだ」と語った。
articles.body:
Sports Broadcasting Hall of Famer Ernie Johnson will retire as host of "Inside the NBA" after the season, saying in a social media video Wednesday that it was his decision to step away and that "it's just time."

Johnson, 70, said he would continue to work, including coverage of the NCAA men's basketball tournament for CBS and Turner Sports.

"Just to be clear, I'm not retiring," Johnson said. "Just cutting back. ... So this is by no means the end. It's just a turning of the page. And I'll forever cherish every chapter we have written with 'Inside the NBA.'"

Johnson acknowledged that he has dealt with heart issues in recent years. He said he was doing well but that the health matters helped him realize the importance of time with family, adding "I just want to slow down a bit."

"Ernie Johnson is one of sports media's most respected and beloved figures," ESPN chairman Jimmy Pitaro said in a statement. "For more than three decades, he has been the heart of 'Inside the NBA,' helping create one of the most iconic and entertaining studio shows in sports. We are grateful for Ernie's extraordinary contributions and look forward to celebrating him throughout the season."

Johnson has worked for Turner Sports since 1989 and began hosting "Inside the NBA" a year later. The show -- led by its current quartet of Johnson, Charles Barkley, Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal -- has won more than 20 Sports Emmy Awards over the decades. The show transitioned from TNT Sports to ESPN and ABC starting last season.

Along with Johnson's announcement, Charles Barkley has previously said this will also be his final season on "Inside the NBA," though the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Famer has changed his mind and returned to the desk in previous years.

The third edition of "Inside the NBA" on ESPN will be held Wednesday, when the Indiana Pacers host the Philadelphia 76ers (7 p.m. ET) and the Oklahoma City Thunder play at Dallas Mavericks. The show is set for 25 regular-season appearances in 2026-27 along with the playoffs through the NBA Finals.

articles.headline: Pass rusher Jaelan Phillips among four Panthers ruled out for TNF vs. Packers
articles.description: The Panthers ruled out four players, including starting OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and left guard Damien Lewis (knee) for "Thursday Night Football."
articles.headlineJa: パサーラッシャーのジェイラン・フィリップスを含む、パナーズの選手4名がパッカーズとのTNF戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: パナーズは、先発OLBのジェイラン・フィリップス（ハムストリング）やレフトガードのデミアン・ルイス（膝）を含む4名の選手について、「サースデー・ナイト・フットボール」の欠場を発表した。
articles.body:
GREEN BAY, Wis. -- The Carolina Panthers ruled out four players, including starting outside linebacker Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and left guard Damien Lewis (knee), Wednesday for "Thursday Night Football" against the Green Bay Packers at Lambeau Field.

Phillips, Lewis, fill-in starting cornerback Akayleb Evans (triceps/knee) and backup guard Torricelli Simpkins III (ankle) were sidelined throughout the week of practice and were officially shelved for the primetime matchup by the team ahead of its trip to Green Bay.

Starting defensive lineman Bobby Brown III was listed as questionable entering the Week 8 clash. Brown, Evans, Lewis and Simpkins all sustained their injuries in Sunday's home loss against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, while Phillips will miss a second consecutive game after reinjuring his hamstring against his former team, the Philadelphia Eagles, in a Week 6 road win.

Key Packers players ruled out include center Sean Rhyan (ankle), guard Travis Glover (knee) and linebacker Zaire Franklin. Wide receiver Matthew Golden (knee/toe) and defensive tackle Devonte Wyatt (ankle) are listed as questionable.

Phillips will once again be replaced by a committee opposite fellow starting Patrick Jones II. Princely Umanmielen, a 2025 third-round pick, and veteran Trevis Gipson will rotate with special teams ace Nick Hampton, who was promoted to the 53-man roster this week, at the position.

Lewis' replacement is less clear, as coach Dave Canales offered up a couple of different options Tuesday. The coach mentioned Corey Bullock, who started in place of Lewis in Week 4 against the Detroit Lions, as a potential choice.

Evans started at cornerback -- with rookie Will Lee III -- in place of injured starters Jaycee Horn (quad) and Mike Jackson (groin), who have been on injured reserve since Week 4. Lee and Chau Smith-Wade are the lone healthy cornerbacks on the Panthers' 53-man roster heading into the battle with Green Bay.

The Panthers are expected to elevate cornerback Marco Wilson and guard/tackle Jake Curhan from the practice squad for Thursday night's game, a league source told ESPN. Coach Dave Canales had mused about Curhan and Wilson potentially filling in for Lewis and Evans on Tuesday. If Wilson starts Thursday, it would be his first NFL start since 2023.

If Brown isn't able to play, TeRah Edwards would probably return to the game-day rotation. Derrick Brown, Lee Hunter, Turk Wharton and Aaron Hall would headline the group.

Kicker Ryan Fitzgerald was added to the injury report Tuesday with an illness, but he doesn't have an injury status before the game.

articles.headline: Bologna storm back to hand Milan, Amorim first Serie A loss
articles.description: Samuel Mbangula fired a hat trick as Bologna beat AC Milan 4-2 to hand the hosts a first Serie A loss of the season.
articles.headlineJa: ボローニャが猛追、ミランとアモリムに今季セリエA初の敗戦を喫させる
articles.descriptionJa: サミュエル・ムバンギュラがハットトリックを決め、ボローニャがACミランに4-2で勝利。ホームチームに今シーズンセリエAで初めての敗戦を味わわせた。
articles.body:
Samuel Mbangula fired a hat trick as Bologna beat AC Milan 4-2 to seal their first Serie A win at San Siro in over 10 years -- and hand the hosts a first league loss of the season.

Belgian forward Mbangula, on loan from Werder Bremen, opened the scoring and struck twice more after Milan defender Davide Bartesaghi's own goal had given the visitors a second-half lead.

Milan midfielder Alphadjo Cissè scored twice, cancelling out Mbangula's opener and then giving his side a halftime lead, but it was not enough as Ruben Amorim saw his team lose for the first time in Serie A since his arrival.

Bologna had won their previous two league games on the road and they silenced the home fans in the eighth minute when Mbangula converted from inside the box after being teed up by Nadir Zortea.

The visitors' lead was short-lived. Milan's on-loan Nottingham Forest winger Omari Hutchinson dispossessed Bologna defender Arthur Theate and squared for Cisse to steer in the equaliser.

Hutchinson then had a hand as Milan took a 27th-minute lead, driving into the box before Fikayo Tomori set up Cisse, who stabbed home his seventh goal of the season in all competitions at the back post.

Bologna boss Raffaele Palladino made a triple change on the hour-mark, sending on Juan Miranda, Nicolò Cambiaghi and Martin Vitík, and his side responded with two goals in as many minutes to turn the game on its head.

Bartesaghi diverted a free kick into the box past his own goalkeeper to level it up at 2-2 in the 60th minute and Mbangula lashed home his second from Miranda's assist.

Francesco Camarda and Sankhoun Diawara both headed narrowly wide for Milan as they chased a late equaliser, but Bologna sealed all three points on the counter-attack as Mbangula swept home Odgaard's cross for his hat trick.

Information from PA was used in this recap.

articles.headline: LaLiga chief Javier Tebas holds talks with Chinese ambassador over Mbappé-Mao controversy
articles.description: LaLiga president Javier Tebas has met with China's Ambassador to Spain, Yao Jing, to "find solutions" to the Kylian Mbappé alleged dictator comment.
articles.body:
LaLiga president Javier Tebas has met with China's Ambassador to Spain, Yao Jing, to "find solutions" to the Kylian Mbappé alleged dictator comment.

Comments made by the Real Madrid striker regarding a "meme" comparing him to Mao Zedong, the founder of the People's Republic of China, sparked controversy in the Asian country.

EFE reported that Chinese state broadcaster CCTV suspended evening broadcasts of LaLiga matches and any games involving Mbappé.

"Today I held a meeting with the Chinese Ambassador to Spain to discuss the situation arising from Kylian Mbappé's comments and to seek solutions to move past this incident," Tebas wrote on X.

"Over recent years, LaLiga has worked closely with the Chinese authorities, football organisations, broadcasters and businesses in the country to promote the growth and popularity of Spanish football in China, while also contributing to the development and growth of Chinese football itself by sharing our experience, expertise and resources."

 

LaLiga has partnership deals with different Chinese organisations, including a strategic agreement with the Chinese Professional Football League (CFL) through 2029.

Moreover, it has agreements with China Media Group (CMG) for the growth of Chinese football and to bring "our competitions closer to millions of fans."

Tebas said he hopes the "single incident" does not affect their rapport.

"This is a relationship built on mutual respect, trust and cooperation, which we must preserve and continue to strengthen," Tebas wrote. "We are committed to continuing to work together to ensure that a single incident does not undermine the significant progress made or affect the millions of Chinese fans who follow our competitions. China is, and will continue to be, a strategic partner for LaLiga."

- Kylian Mbappé dropped by Chinese brands after alleged dictator comment

- Why Real Madrid's Mbappé, Barcelona's Yamal lost Ballon d'Or

- If Clásico win is any indication, Mourinho's Madrid might just be special again

At least three companies have cut ties with the France and Madrid star since his comment.

Mbappé issued an apology to the Chinese people on Tuesday on his social media, stating that his comment regarding Mao Zedong was "ill-judged."

Real Madrid, who own a percentage of Mbappé's image rights, also joined their player in apologising to the Chinese people.

"Real Madrid C.F. wishes to express its apologies to the Chinese people for any discomfort that may have been caused by the recent words of our player Kylian Mbappé," a club statement said on Wednesday.

"Our club holds deep respect for China, its history, its culture, and its citizens, as well as for the millions of Chinese fans who feel affection and admiration for Real Madrid."

articles.headline: Barcelona fined €602 over Julián Álvarez approach
articles.description: Barcelona have been fined €602 ($669) by the Royal Spanish Football Federation [RFEF] for approaching Julián Álvarez before notifying Atlético Madrid of their interest.
articles.body:
Barcelona have been fined €602 ($669) by the Royal Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) for approaching Julián Álvarez before notifying Atlético Madrid of their interest.

Barça plan to appeal the decision, a source said.

The Spanish champions made several attempts to sign Álvarez in the summer as they sought a new striker to replace the outgoing Robert Lewandowski and Ferran Torres.

Their pursuit of the Argentina forward angered Atlético, who accused Barça of making an illegal approach for the player and subsequently reported them to both the RFEF and FIFA.

FIFA declared it had no jurisdiction over the case, but the RFEF announced a small fine this week after finding Barça made contact with Álvarez's agent at the time, Fernando Hidalgo, before Atlético.

The RFEF's investigation established that a conversation took place between Hidalgo and Barça sporting director Deco on May 15, with the Catalan club's first written communication with Atlético following on May 28.

However, the infringement was only considered a "minor regulatory breach," with it falling under Article 133 -- instead of Article 93 -- of the RFEF's Disciplinary Code and, therefore, carrying a smaller punishment.

Article 93 is applied for "conscious and repeated breaches" of the RFEF's regulations.

Barça offered €100 million ($111m) for Álvarez and left the offer on the table until the end of the transfer window, but Atlético CEO Miguel Ángel Gil Marín repeatedly insisted they would not sell to their LaLiga rivals.

Atlético also turned down a €150m ($166m) offer from Real Madrid for Álvarez during the summer, with Arsenal and Paris Saint-Germain also expressing an interest in signing the forward.

Álvarez had revealed a desire to leave, telling ESPN during the World Cup that he felt a transfer would be best for all parties. Sources told ESPN he wanted to join Barça.

His push for a transfer saw him booed by Atlético fans at the start of the season, although bridges have started to be mended in recent weeks.

- Why Real Madrid's Mbappé, Barcelona's Yamal lost Ballon d'Or

- Yamal excited despite Ballon d'Or miss: 'Good things take time'

The 26-year-old has scored in each of Atlético's last two games, against Stuttgart and Deportivo A Coruña, and after netting the winner in a 1-0 win against the latter on Saturday, he apologised to supporters.

"I wanted to say sorry to our fans for my comments during the World Cup," he told Movistar of his decision to speak out in search of a move.

"It was ‌a ⁠mistake -- the way I said what I said and the timing. I understand why the supporters are angry. If I were a fan, I'd be angry too. Especially given how they've supported me since I arrived."

Atlético have won eight of their opening 10 LaLiga games and are second in the table, just two points behind leaders Barcelona.

articles.headline: Man United's Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes hold 'clear-the-air' talks - reports
articles.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick and captain Bruno Fernandes have held clear-the-air talks.
articles.body:
Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick and captain Bruno Fernandes have held clear-the-air talks.

The Press Association understands Carrick and Fernandes met at United's Carrington training ground for talks that were separate to a wider meeting of the full squad to discuss a way forward from their current predicament.

Fernandes appeared to question Carrick's tactics in the wake of last week's 4-1 Champions League loss to Como, and was dropped for Sunday's Premier League match at home to Bournemouth, remaining on the bench throughout as United fell to stunning 3-0 loss that piled the pressure on Carrick.

However, after the talks, Fernandes is now considered available for the crunch match away to Chelsea on Saturday.

Fernandes, who lately has looked a shadow of the player of who was named the PFA Players' player of the year last term, is described as being back to the best version of himself over the past 48 hours following a difficult period on and off the pitch.

Sunday's result left United down in 16th place in the Premier League with only one league win -- over newly-promoted Ipswich -- this term.

Many observers had expected the axe to fall on the boss in the wake of Sunday's defeat, but Carrick took training on Tuesday with the club resolving to give the 45-year-old more time to turn things around.

Fernandes was the second player to make outspoken comments in a post-match interview in the space of two weeks, with Lisandro Martínez having taken aim at the club's hierarchy in an explosive interview following the 2-0 Champions League loss to Atlético Madrid on Oct.13.

Carrick took charge of the team in January, stabilising the club after Ruben Amorim's often turbulent reign, overseeing an excellent run of results which culminated in a third-placed finish and a return to the Champions League.

The popular former United midfielder was rewarded with a two-year deal in the summer, but just five months after signing it he has come under major scrutiny with United having won only two of their 12 matches in all competitions, those against Ipswich and Champions League minnows Sabah.

- Michael Carrick to lead Man United vs. Chelsea amid uncertain future - sources

- Gary Neville: 'Really surprised' but 'happy' Michael Carrick set to continue as Man United boss

- Wayne Rooney's son, Kai scores, 4 goals for Man United under-18s vs. Burnley

But while Carrick's position in the dugout means he faces much of the scrutiny, Martínez's comments in Madrid focused higher up the chain of command.

Director of Football Jason Wilcox and chief executive Omar Berrada are also under the microscope after what is seen as a failure to properly strengthen the squad in the summer, when United put all their focus on midfield reinforcements but failed to sign either a left-back or a striker.

On Sunday at Old Trafford, it was notable that fans continued to sing Carrick's name while also turning their fire on those higher up.

articles.headline: Mussolini's great-grandson scores first goal for Lazio
articles.description: Romano Floriani Mussolini, the great-grandson of former Italian dictator Benito Mussolini, scored his first goal for Lazio on Tuesday.
articles.headlineJa: ムッソリーニのひ孫、ラツィオで初ゴールを決める
articles.descriptionJa: イタリアの元独裁者ベニート・ムッソリーニのひ孫であるロマーノ・フロリアーニ・ムッソリーニが、火曜日にラツィオで自身初となるゴールを決めた。
articles.body:
Romano Floriani Mussolini, great-grandson of the former fascist Italian dictator Benito Mussolini, scored his first goal for Lazio on Tuesday.

The 23-year-old Floriani Mussolini -- who has "Romano" on the back of his jersey -- struck in the 16th minute for Lazio's third goal in its 6-2 rout of Sassuolo in Serie A.

His celebrations were initially cut short by the offside flag, but the Lazio youth product managed to celebrate properly when the goal was given on video review.

It was also Mussolini's first goal in the Italian top flight and only the second of his career. His first had come in the second-division, two years ago, while on loan at Juve Stabia.

The defender, whose full name is Romano Benito Floriani Mussolini, is related to Benito Mussolini through the maternal side of his family.

He is the son of Alessandra Mussolini, a former member of the European parliament for the Forza Italia party.

He has said publicly that he has no interest in politics.

Mussolini was prime minister of Italy from 1922 to 1943 following a fascist coup in the country.

articles.headline: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane gets hero's welcome on Bayern Munich return
articles.description: After an historic Ballon d'Or win and an emotional speech, Harry Kane arrived back in Germany on Tuesday to a hero's welcome at Bayern Munich.
